name: git_gate
description: Before Claude makes a git move (commit, push, merge, deploy...), asks the git-moves Ada model what Chris would do in that repo state, from his own past rulings; records what he decides so it learns

check.description: What to do about one git move: proceed, fetch_first, branch_first, open_pr, check_unpushed, use_main_checkout, restart_from_main, ask_chris or stop, with the precedents it stands on

record.description: Teach it: one git move and what Chris decided about it
